verdict.rationale: Model routing is a fair axis for an agentic coding platform, but the evidence shows only manual model choice: users pick a reasoning model from a drop-down under the prompt box. There is no documented automatic per-task model selection. The 'Model Decision' rule activation mode governs when a rule is applied, not which model is used, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the tool automatically pick the best model for each task
